fusions.name: Seam Splitter
fusions.desc: Snaps through the one gap in the target's armour, dealing 30 damage and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. The blow ignores armour.

fusions.name: Pinprick Jab
fusions.desc: A quick lunge that deals 5 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full range, 4 tiles away.

fusions.name: Sighted Breath
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Fine Edge
fusions.desc: Your piercing attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour, and your other abilities come round 5% sooner.
